synthesis.body: pytest's tmp_path resolves through /private/var on macOS, so no test ever crosses a symlinked ancestor. Code that refuses symlinked path *components* passes the whole suite while failing for real users the moment they pass /tmp/... (/tmp is a symlink to private/tmp on macOS; a symlinked $HOME or checkout does the same on Linux). When a path guard refuses links, scope it to the leaf and its destinations, and add an explicit test that a symlinked ancestor is accepted.

title: pytest tmp_path hides symlinked-ancestor path bugs
